original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Characterize any twelve-row rank-at-most-three matrix obstruction to two ordered nonzero blocks of total size eight; exclude every such obstruction over F_2, and settle the rational anchor case with at least one odd tied cardinality. The general rational twelve-line box>=8 question remains open.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first continuation of PR3435 after refreshed canonical main/revision6 and complete open/closed PR and Discussion overlap checks. A full rational proof was not obtained; the useful independently reviewable result is an arbitrary-field structural reduction, its F_2 corollary, and an exact counterexample to a tempting intermediate lemma.
bottleneck_link: Narrows the unresolved twelve-line F-star threshold to rank-three all-even-tie instances and restricts failures of the sufficient two-block route. It does not claim that the stronger matrix route is necessary for a box witness.
stop_rule: Structural checkpoint after approximately 20 minutes; finish with a scoped proof, counterexample or reusable obstruction within approximately 60 minutes. Stop unpromising search branches early; no unstructured directed-zero census.
evidence: PROOF.md proves rank-two partitions, prescribed prefix extensions, factor multiplicity and zero-degree bounds for a twelve-row obstruction, and the F_2 incidence contradiction. Exact controls include the rational eight-row no-four/no-independent-triple counterexample, positive anchor witnesses and source binding. Bounded discovery searches are not proof premises.
author: Sagar Thakrar, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate proof, exact-control and independent-review agents. Same-session AI reviews are not independent human acceptance or formal proof.

open_questions.question: Can a rational twelve-row rank-three matrix with nonzero diagonal fail to contain two ordered nonzero blocks of total size eight?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A negative answer would settle the twelve-line box floor by the retained asymmetric transfer.
open_questions.first_step: Study only factor multiplicities at most two and zero row/column degrees at most five; PROOF.md excludes every other case. The F_2 argument does not extend merely by reducing rational factors modulo two.
open_questions.blocked_by: The projective line count is specific to the seven directions over F_2; no general-field exclusion of the residual class is proved.

open_questions.question: If the stronger two-block condition fails, do all rational twelve-line canonical anchor instances still have box>=8?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Two-block witnesses are sufficient, not necessary. A matrix obstruction alone is not an F-star counterexample.
open_questions.first_step: Keep nonempty canonical ties, actual rational valuations and the directed order. The odd-tie case is settled here, leaving only tied cardinality two on every row.
open_questions.blocked_by: Canonical reductions of the remaining all-even case have zero diagonal over F_2, so the finite-field theorem's nonzero-diagonal hypothesis fails.
